highlights: On macOS, sign in to Gemini again after you update. Then a Gemini agent with Workspace only access can use your Google sign-in.
Choose a light theme in Settings > General > Theme. On macOS, you can also turn on a transparent window.
Give agents named browser profiles, so different agents can use different accounts on the same site.
Open the steps of an agent's turn to see its thinking, its tool steps and its memory searches.
When a task needs an API key, the agent shows a secure form. The key does not go into the chat.
